articles.title: The Case of the Disappearing, Reappearing White House Ballroom Stairs
articles.description: Derided by architects as serving no purpose, a grand staircase was never approved by a planning commission but appears back in President Trump’s plans.
categories: white house east wing and ballroom (washington, dc)

analysis.summary: A grand staircase in the White House ballroom that was previously removed and criticized by architects for lacking purpose has reportedly reappeared in President Trump's plans for the building, despite never receiving approval from a planning commission.
